Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.
Card Q&A.q: I activated this card's [On Deletion] effect and returned it from the trash to my hand by processing the first part.Can I then process the part of this card's effect that follows after "then"?
